verdict.line: You lose if you let Garen stack Q autos into free (P) procs and trade at his empowered W timing; you win if you bait Q whiffs and force him to fight without silence up.

brief.thesis: This is a 52.1% Fiora lane over 407 games because Garen's entire trade pattern depends on landing Q (Decisive Strike) to silence your W (Riposte) parry window before he commits E (Judgment) spin. If you play around his Q cooldown instead of his cooldowns in general, you flip a coin-flip lane into a read-and-punish one — the data's own tip confirms the silence-into-W-denial is the core interaction to manage.

theirWindow.when: Q is up and he's in melee range
theirWindow.what: He can silence your W and immediately spin E without fear of a parry punish, so don't stand still to auto-trade here — back off a step or force him to walk up and burn Q just to close distance.

yourWindow.when: his Q is on cooldown (post-trade or post-engage)
yourWindow.what: This is when Riposte is live and safe to use. Bait an E spin or an auto with W up so you can parry, negate the damage, and get the slow plus the guaranteed riposte damage back onto him.

start.why: 91.4% pick rate at 51.3% win over 466 games — the sustained auto damage and lifesteal let you match Garen's early poke without falling behind on trades.

boots.why: 75.7% pick rate at 51.6% win — Garen's damage is almost entirely physical (Q, E, and auto-based (P)), so the flat reduction directly blunts his all-in burst.

core.why: 41.4%-pick core path (61.2% win over 129 games) — the active heal and cleave give you the sustain to out-trade Garen's regen and win extended fights.
Follows Hydra in the highest win-rate path (61.2% over 129 games) — the damage and tenacity/movement spike let you close on and stick to Garen once he's forced to fight without Q up.
Caps the top build path — the damage-over-time conversion smooths out Garen's burst windows (Q-E-auto strings) so his spikes don't delete you before your sustain kicks in.

runes.keystoneWhy: 62.7% of games run Conqueror (10.2% pick share) because it rewards exactly the sustained-auto, extended-trade pattern you need to out-heal Garen's own (P) regen over a long fight.

summoners.why: 89.8% pick rate at 53.3% win — Ignite denies Garen's (P) passive regen after a trade or all-in, which is the single biggest lever you have against his sustain.

playing.title: Trade only after his Q is spent
playing.detail: Never initiate an auto-trade or W-parry attempt while Decisive Strike is up — he silences W and removes your only hard counter to his E spin.

playing.title: Bait E before you commit
playing.detail: Hold W (Riposte) for his Judgment spin specifically; parrying it gives you the biggest single damage swing and slow in the exchange.

playing.title: Track his (P) stack timer
playing.detail: If he hasn't taken damage recently, his passive is close to healing him back to full — apply a Q poke to reset it before he can capitalize on the free sustain.

playing.title: Use Ignite on his all-in, not on kill setups
playing.detail: Popping Ignite the moment he commits E denies the (P) healing that would otherwise let him win the extended trade.

playing.title: Play around minion waves for W parries
playing.detail: Position so canon minion autos don't accidentally eat your Riposte window — you want it saved exclusively for his Q or E.

playing.title: Look for R execute post-6
playing.detail: Once you hit level 6, any all-in where he drops below roughly a third HP should be closed out with Grand Challenge's true damage rather than extending the trade.

playing.title: Kite in extended fights post-9
playing.detail: Once Hydra/Trinity come online, use E (Bladework) dashes to reposition around his E spin radius instead of standing still to auto-trade.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the trade-pattern and cooldown-tracking reasoning is my own tactical read on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Do not let Garen activate his (P) by constantly dealing damage with [Q]. Be careful as Garen’s (Q) has silence, preventing you from using [W].
